items.point: The term 'civilisation' generally refers to an advanced stage of human societies that possesses at least: (1) government and administration, (2) urbanism with town planning and water management, (3) crafts managing raw materials like stone or metal and producing finished goods, (4) trade both internally and externally, (5) writing for records and communication, (6) cultural ideas expressed through art, architecture, literature, or social customs, and (7) productive agriculture sufficient to feed cities.
